disposition: Empty fallback in digest hash validation has the same invalid-digest outcome. coverage-audit.test.mjs 257-271 rejects invalid snapshot/artifact byte counts and hashes before publication.
Empty fallback in source-file hash validation has the same closed source-metadata rejection outcome. coverage-audit.test.mjs 259-260 verifies invalid source bytes and hashes publish no audit.

Exact raw/source file counts are required first; unknown, ambiguous and duplicate mappings are rejected. Every accepted raw file adds one unique known source, making the final mapped-size inequality unreachable. Missing and duplicate raw sources are tested.
strictArtifactRef admits only nonempty relative basenames, so the resolved artifact cannot escape its root. coverage-audit.test.mjs 273-274 rejects traversal and nested references.
Basename references and readRegular rejection of symlinks/non-files ensure immutable regular artifact children resolve within the canonical artifact root; this repeats the containment guard.

Codeless adapter_failure fallback is unreachable: executable admission, adapterCommand, invokeAdapter and assertAdmission failures carry codes; runPackageCommand child failures are classified by invokeAdapter. bootstrap.test.mjs 1055-1064 verifies version admission failure and independent preflight checks.
